name: Lucette Riella Britton
source:
"You cannot rely on anyone but yourself. You cannot trust anyone but yourself."

The heroine and the Crown Princess of Angielle. Ever since the death of her mother in the Great War, Lucette has become increasingly cold and resentful toward her father and new step-family. When Lucette is suddenly cursed only months away from her eighteenth birthday, she is forced to do whatever it takes to get her life back.

Has gone from riches to rags. Is no longer remembered as the crown princess of Angielle, and now has to live her life as a peasant.
